svg.title: The complete Fourier-space evolution used in the three-amplitude APFC solver, with its linear density and wavevector terms, nonlinear self- and cross-amplitude coupling, and triangular coupling written explicitly.
svg.desc: LaTeX source \frac{\partial\widehat A_j}{\partial t}=-|\bm q+\bm k_j|^2[r+3\bar\psi^2+(|\bm q|^2+2\bm k_j\cdot\bm q)^2]\widehat A_j-3\widehat{A_j(|A_j|^2+2\textstyle\sum_{s\ne j}|A_s|^2)}-6\bar\psi\widehat{A_k^*A_\ell^*}
